title: Campaigns
subtitle: Email campaigns with a built-in holdout, plus the templates and audiences they use.

templates.dialogDescription: Write the subject and the HTML body. Variables are filled in per contact when the email is sent.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive this template?
archiveConfirm.description: "{name}" will no longer be offered for new campaigns. Campaigns already using it are not affected.

empty.title: No templates yet
empty.description: Create a template to write the email a campaign sends.

variables.title: Variables
variables.hint: Select a variable to insert it at the cursor.

help.title: Template syntax
help.intro: Templates use a safe subset of Liquid. Anything else is rejected with the line and column.
help.noIncludes: Includes and custom tags are not available.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Rendered by the server with sample data from the saved template.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.saveFirst: Save the template to see a preview.
preview.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. The preview shows the last saved version.

segments.dialogDescription: Choose who belongs to this audience. The count updates as you change the filters.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive this segment?
archiveConfirm.description: "{name}" will no longer be offered for new campaigns. Campaigns already using it are not affected.

empty.title: No segments yet
empty.description: Create a segment to target a part of your contacts. Without one, a campaign goes to everyone with an email address.

fields.ownersHint: Contacts owned by any of the chosen people.
fields.countriesHint: Two-letter country codes, for example PL or UA.
fields.tagsHint: Contacts with any of the chosen tags.
fields.daysSinceLastOrderHint: Contacts whose last order is at least this many days old. Leave empty to ignore.

rfm.title: RFM segments
rfm.unavailable: Not available yet. RFM filters appear once customer scoring has run.

builder.title: New campaign
builder.subtitle: Your draft is saved automatically while you work.
builder.conflict: This draft was changed somewhere else, so autosave is paused. Your edits here are kept.

template.name: Campaign name
template.chooseHint: Pick the email this campaign sends.
template.noSelection: Choose a template to see how the email looks.

audience.chooseHint: Pick a saved segment, or send to everyone with an email address.
audience.rfmUnavailable: RFM filters are not available yet. They appear once customer scoring has run.

experiment.whyBody: The holdout is a random group that deliberately gets no email. Comparing it with the people who did receive the email shows the difference in purchases between the two groups.
experiment.tradeoff: A larger holdout gives a more reliable result but reaches fewer people now.
experiment.mde: Rough guide: a difference of about {percent} percentage points in conversion could be detected.
experiment.mdeNote: After the audience is frozen, the estimate uses the real group sizes; it still assumes a 20% baseline conversion.
experiment.emptyAudience: This audience has no contacts yet, so there is nothing to compare.

targeting.title: Who gets the email
targeting.noPermission: You need permission to run predictions to use this option.
targeting.shareLabel: Share of the audience to email
targeting.scoresNote: Uses the latest scores. If none are available, you will be told when you prepare the campaign.

all.title: Everyone in the audience
all.description: Every contact in the audience is eligible.

top_uplift.title: Top by predicted uplift
top_uplift.description: Email only the contacts the model predicts will show the largest difference in response to the email.

top_rfm.title: Top by RFM score
top_rfm.description: Email only the most recent, frequent and valuable customers.

uplift.notReady: Run scoring first. Top uplift needs scores from a completed uplift run.

review.name: Campaign
review.prepareHint: Preparing freezes the audience and the holdout split. After that they cannot be changed.
review.preparing: Freezing the audience. This page updates on its own.
review.srmWarning: The split between the groups looks uneven compared with what was planned. Check the audience before relying on the result.
review.scoresUnavailable: No scores are available yet for this targeting.
review.mdeLine: Detectable difference: about {percent} percentage points (assumes 20% baseline conversion).
review.stopped: Preparing stopped before it finished. Resume to continue; the people already assigned keep their group.
review.saveFailed: Your latest changes are not saved yet, so the campaign was not prepared. Fix the save problem above and try again.
review.scoreModelPending: The model is fixed when the audience is frozen.

empty.title: No campaigns yet
empty.description: Create a campaign to send an email to part of your contacts and measure what it really changed.

emptyFiltered.title: No campaigns match
emptyFiltered.description: Try a different search or clear the filters.

detail.title: Campaign
detail.readOnly: This campaign can no longer be edited.

notFound.title: Campaign not found
notFound.description: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.description: Stop receiving marketing emails from this sender.

confirm.body: Do you want to stop receiving these emails?

done.title: You are unsubscribed
done.body: You will not receive more of these emails. You can close this page.

invalid.title: This link no longer works
invalid.body: The unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired. Use the link in a more recent email, or reply to the sender.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.body: Please wait a moment, then try again.

unsubscribe.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

send.testSent: Test email sent to your address.
send.testRateLimited: Too many test emails were sent. Try again later.
send.testHint: The test email goes only to you, with sample data. Nobody in the audience receives anything until you start sending.

confirm.title: Start sending now?
confirm.description: {count, plural, one {# email goes} other {# emails go}} out as soon as you confirm. Emails cannot be recalled or stopped once they are sent. The holdout group receives nothing.
confirm.descriptionUnknown: Emails go out as soon as you confirm. They cannot be recalled once they are sent. The holdout group receives nothing.

progress.title: Sending progress
progress.running: Sending is in progress. This page updates on its own.

queued.label: Queued
queued.help: Waiting for their turn to be sent.

failed.label: Failed
failed.help: Could not be sent. Retries ran out or the problem is permanent.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.help: The send was interrupted, so we cannot tell whether it went out. We did not retry, to avoid sending twice.

suppressed.label: Suppressed
suppressed.help: Not sent because the address unsubscribed or is on the suppression list.

results.title: Results
results.refreshQueued: Refresh requested. The figures update in a moment.

verdict.closesOn: The comparison is shown when the window closes on {date}.
verdict.finalizing: The window has closed; final figures are being calculated.
verdict.unreliable: The group sizes differ from the planned split by more than chance explains, so this comparison is not reliable and no conclusion is drawn.
verdict.inconclusive: No conclusion can be drawn from this comparison.
verdict.notStarted: This campaign has not been sent yet, so there is nothing to compare.
verdict.noNumbers: The comparison cannot be calculated from the data available.
verdict.measurableLift: In this group, {treatment}% of the people who received the email converted, against {holdout}% in the holdout: a difference of {lift} percentage points. The data are consistent with a difference between {low} and {high} percentage points (95% interval). This describes what happened in this campaign; it does not by itself explain why.
verdict.noMeasurableEffect: In this group, the difference was {lift} percentage points, and the 95% interval ({low} to {high}) includes zero. These data cannot tell an effect from chance.
verdict.noMeasurableEffectMde: With this holdout, only differences of about {mde} percentage points or more could have been detected, so a smaller effect cannot be ruled out.

results.simulatedNote: This is a demo campaign. Its orders and its effect were generated by a simulation, not by real customers.
results.demoNote: Historic demo campaign: no email was sent; the groups are compared on the dataset's real orders.
results.revenueNote: Revenue difference × group size is the difference in mean revenue between the two groups, multiplied by the size of the email group. It describes the gap in this data, not a proven cause.

table.caption: Conversion and revenue of the email group and the holdout group

chart.title: Difference between the groups
chart.alt: Difference between the groups: {lift} percentage points, 95% interval from {low} to {high} percentage points.
chart.caption: Difference in conversion between the email group and the holdout, in percentage points, with its 95% interval.

results.noInterval: The interval cannot be drawn because the data are insufficient.
results.mdeCaution: A small holdout can only detect large differences. The smallest difference this campaign could detect is shown above; a smaller real effect would not show up as measurable.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.subtitle: Everyone in the audience, whether they got the email, and what they did afterwards.

visibility.hiddenNote: Some names, conversions and revenue are hidden because your access does not include all contacts.

scanning.title: Still searching
scanning.description: No matching recipients on this part of the list yet. Load the next part to keep searching.

email.hiddenNote: Some email addresses are hidden because your access does not include all contacts.
